rules.title: Fungal conditions are favorable
rules.message: High humidity with rain can favor several tomato diseases. Inspect lower leaves, stems and dense canopy areas today.

rules.title: Keep a closer eye on foliage
rules.message: Humidity is high. Inspect leaves during your field round and note anything unusual.

fallback.title: No major weather-driven alert
fallback.message: Continue normal crop inspection. Report any visible change even when weather risk is low.
